comment_auth: ONE-REQUEST smoke test, Ashburn, self-run. Put the key secret in the environment with a hidden prompt so it never lands in shell history or chat: run 'read -s OCI_GENAI_API_KEY && export OCI_GENAI_API_KEY', paste the key at the hidden prompt, press Enter.
comment_region: Ashburn per your call. Base URL derives to https://inference.generativeai.us-ashburn-1.oci.oraclecloud.com/openai/v1/chat/completions.
comment_model: Llama 4 Maverick, the id on your access list. This is our pick for the smoke test, named visibly; it settles whether your Ashburn key reaches an on-demand Llama 4.
comment_max_attempts: Hard count bound: exactly one request, cumulative across runs. Re-running this config will not send a second request - delete the ledger file to reset, or raise this.
comment_retries: No retries: a 429 or failure ends the test instead of spending again.
comment_budget: Second gate only. The endpoint's billing metric is UNVERIFIED, so this is not a proven cap. IF the endpoint meters characters like the price list's Maverick entry ($0.18 per 1M chars), the reservation for this single call is 16,384 chars, about $0.003. If it meters some other way, the true cost of the one request is unknown - that is the risk you accept by running the smoke test.
comment_cap: Per-attempt reservation ceiling: prompt bytes + 200 overhead + 113 x 128 reply term = about 15K bytes.
